description: Angular component for configuring time series chart threshold rows in a widget, including form controls, validation, and data binding.

classes.name: TimeSeriesChartThresholdRowComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing a row of threshold settings in a time series chart widget.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscriptions for value changes.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, especially yAxisIds.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for propagating value changes.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on component state.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates form controls with provided threshold data.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validators based on threshold type.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates changes based on form values.
